title: lastrea goldieana
intro: Lastrea goldieana, commonly known as the Goldie's fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea goldieana include its ability to act as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
